senses.gloss: m. (preced.) merciful, compassionate, sympathetic; הר׳ the Merciful, God.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 9:30">Tosef. B. Kam. IX, 30</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 13:18">Deut. XIII, 18</cite>) <he>כל זמן שאתה ר׳ הר׳ וכ׳</he> if thou art merciful, the Merciful will have mercy on thee.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 81b:2">Kidd. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>הר׳ יצילנו וכ׳</he> the Lord save us from evil inclinations.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 103:9">Midr. Till. to Ps. CIII, 13</cite> <he>כר׳ שבאבות</he> like the most merciful of the patriarchs (Abraham).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 145b:12">B. Bath. 145ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 15:15">Prov. XV, 15</cite>) <he>זה ר׳</he> this means the sympathetic man.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:13">Snh. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>אם ר׳ הוא … אם ר׳ מלא רחמים הוא וכ׳</he> if he (the human king) is merciful, he puts half of them (the rebels) to death; if he is most merciful, he chastises the prominent &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="T00532"><he>רַחֲמָנִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="T00532"><he>רַחֲמָנִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yevamot 79a:3">Yeb. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>שלשה … הר׳ וכ׳</he> this nation (Israel) is known by three characteristic features, they are merciful, chaste, charitable; Y. Kidd. IV, 65ᶜ; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 17:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII</cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 113b:7-15">Pes. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>שלשה חייהן … הר׳ וכ׳</he> there are three persons whose lives are no lives, the sympathetic, the hot-tempered, and the delicate.

M. Kat. 27ᵇ (to those mourning to excess) אמר הקב״ה אי אתם ר׳ בו יותר ממני (Ms. M. omits בו) the Lord says, you do not bear him more love than I do?; a. e.—Fem. (b. h.) רַחֲמָנִית. Tanḥ. Vayetsé 8 אמר לה הקב״ה את ר׳ וכ׳ the Lord said to her (Leah), thou art compassionate, I will also have compassion on her (Rachel).—Pl. רַחֲמָנִיּוֹת.
<cite ref="Megillah 14b:6">Meg. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני שהנשים ר׳ הן</he> because women are compassionate.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 2:1">Ex. R. s. 2</cite>, beg. <he>מדותיו … ר׳ הן</he> the dealings and dispositions of the Lord are full of love; a. e.
